description.en: Hyōgo Prefecture is a prefecture of Japan located in the Kansai region of Honshu. Hyōgo Prefecture has a population of 5,292,593 and a geographic area of 8,400 square kilometres .
description.zh-CN: 兵库县是日本近畿地方的一个县，面積8400.82km²，縣治為神户市。总人口約531萬，縣內城市大部分集中在濑户内海沿岸。

description.en: Nara Prefecture is an inland prefecture of Japan located in the Kansai region of Honshu. As of 2020, Nara Prefecture has a population of 1,321,805 and has a geographic area of 3,691 square kilometres .

description.en: Shiga Prefecture is an inland prefecture of Japan in the Kansai region of Honshu. Shiga Prefecture has a population of 1,398,972 as of 1 February 2025 and has a geographic area of 4,017 km2 .

description.en: Kyoto Prefecture is a prefecture of Japan located in the Kansai region of Honshu. It has a population of 2.48 million and has a geographic area of 4,612 square kilometres .

description.en: The Kansai region , a.k.a. Kinki region , is a region of Japan that lies in the southern-central portion of Japan's main island, Honshū.
description.zh-CN: 近畿地方是日本本州中西部的地理區域，因其主體在三關以西故又稱關西地方。由京都府、大阪府、滋賀縣、兵庫縣、奈良縣、和歌山縣、三重縣等2府5縣構成，有時亦會加入福井縣、德島縣。
description.zh-TW: 近畿地方是日本本州中西部的地理區域，因其主體在三關以西故又稱關西地方。由京都府、大阪府、滋賀縣、兵庫縣、奈良縣、和歌山縣、三重縣等2府5縣構成，有時亦會加入福井縣、德島縣。
